label: PF Backlog 632
title: Design-system catalog store + selection engine (Go)
body:
## Problem / why
No machine-readable mapping from product type to a design direction; tokens are hardcoded M3.

## Goal & value
PF can SELECT a ranked design direction from the idea.

## In scope
- New store config/design-systems.json (per system: product_types, style, stack, palette, radius/type/motion dials, component_set, a11y target).
- Go selection engine go/pfcore/design_system.go (REPORT 3 tree, ranked candidates).
- Expose design.select / design.catalog via core/go_host.py.

## Out of scope
- UI to browse the catalog (dashboard work, separate).

## Definition of Done
- Store registered; no Tier-1 palette leaks into components.
- Unit test for select().

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
